description: This PHP class 'EmploymentStatusService' provides business logic for managing employment status entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations, searching, and normalization of employment status data, leveraging a DAO layer and traits for normalization.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusService
classes.description: A service class that manages employment status entities, providing methods for CRUD, search, and data normalization, acting as an intermediary between controllers and DAO layer.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmploymentStatusDao, instantiating if not already set.

methods.name: setEmploymentStatusDao
methods.description: Sets the EmploymentStatusDao instance used by the service.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Fetches an EmploymentStatus entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Saves or updates an EmploymentStatus entity.

methods.name: deleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Deletes employment statuses based on provided IDs.

methods.name: searchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Searches for employment statuses based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employment statuses matching search parameters.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusArray
methods.description: Retrieves all employment statuses and normalizes the data into an array.
